title: Enterprise Support: posted eligible source spending for physical-quantity reconciliation
content:
Enterprise Support — posted eligible source spending for physical-quantity reconciliation.

## Decision basis

For physical-quantity reconciliation: Sum posted primary support consumption entries quantity for the exact original source charge and service period; reversed or unrelated periods are excluded.

## Hypothetical case

For physical-quantity reconciliation: Suppose two hypothetical qualifying records for the specified source and service period contain quantities of 12 and 8 in the stated unit. Their contribution totals 20. A record for another source or period does not enter that total.
